summary: Iter 5 frontend testing of NeuroVue: 5 of 7 requested flows PASS, 2 critical bugs found. PASS: dashboard renders without ReferenceError (inflatedState/inflatedOverlay hooks confirmed working), MNI152 base loads with toast, Clear All clears overlay & 3D mesh state (active count 1→0), clip-plane slider responsive, all 5 slice modes (multiplanar/render/axial/coronal/sagittal) clickable, inflated-reload with Polar Angle overlay succeeds. FAIL: (1) Tract upload of .gii file rejected by FileUploader internal validator — UI shows 'Unsupported file format' toast because FileUploader.handleFile() hardcodes allowlist to .nii/.nii.gz/.mgz/.mgh and ignores the `accept` prop; (2) Inflated LH toggle WITHOUT a projected overlay selected (default '— surface only —' option) throws TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toUpperCase)' from niivue's getFileExt — mesh is never added. Works correctly the second time when an overlay (Polar Angle) is selected before toggling. Individual lesion remove button is present with data-testid='remove-{id}' (per LayerControl.jsx:70) and visible in DOM — my generic text query missed it, not a real defect.

ui_bugs.issue: Internal handleFile() hardcodes extension allowlist to .nii/.nii.gz/.mgz/.mgh; ignores the `accept` prop override. Blocks all tract uploads (.trk/.tck/.gii/.vtk/.mz3) because the toast 'Unsupported file format' fires before onFile is invoked. Reproduced by uploading conte69_lh_inflated.gii via upload-tract-button — toast appears, tractLayers stays empty.

Calling loadInflatedBrain with no overlayUrl (when 'inflated-overlay-select' is left at default empty value) crashes inside niivue.loadMeshes → getFileExt with TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toUpperCase)'. Mesh never added. Workaround: user must pick an overlay before toggling LH/RH. Fix: either pass a minimal layers array, omit the layers key when empty, or fall back to nv.loadMeshes([{url:meshUrl, name:id, rgba255:[...]}]) without the layers field when overlayUrl is null.

integration_issues.issue: Even though Dashboard wires handleTractUpload (which validates MESH_EXTS), FileUploader rejects the file first. End-to-end the user can never upload a .trk/.tck/.gii/.vtk via UI.

First-time LH/RH toggle fails when overlay select is left blank; second-time toggle after picking an overlay works. UI never recovers because inflatedState[hemi] is still set to true after the failure (setInflatedState runs even when await throws? actually no — but no user-visible error state means user thinks it succeeded).

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/components/FileUploader.jsx handleFile(): replace hardcoded .nii/.nii.gz/.mgz/.mgh allowlist with one derived from the `accept` prop (split on comma, lowercase, trim leading dot). This unblocks tract uploads as well as any future mesh formats.

Fix /app/frontend/src/components/NiivueViewer.jsx loadInflatedBrain (line 322): when overlayUrl is falsy, omit the `layers` key entirely from the loadMeshes payload OR fall back to a minimal {url, name, rgba255} object. Currently passing layers:[] still triggers a niivue internal path that calls getFileExt on something undefined.

Optional: in Dashboard.handleInflatedToggle, only flip inflatedState to true after loadInflatedBrain resolves with a non-null mesh — otherwise the LH/RH button shows 'ON' even though nothing rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: FileUploader.handleFile hardcoded extension check is the root cause of the tract-upload regression — the component takes an `accept` prop but never uses it for validation. This is a leaky abstraction.

NiivueViewer.loadInflatedBrain passes layers:[] to niivue's loadMeshes; if niivue maps over it without a guard against empty arrays in some code path, the crash can recur. Defensive guard recommended.
Dashboard.jsx still ~580 lines with multiple inline state setters — extracting Inflated and Tract sections into their own components would isolate bugs like the inflated toggle one above.
handleInflatedToggle sets inflatedState=true unconditionally even on load failure; should check the awaited result.

success_rate.frontend: ~71% (5/7 requested flows pass; tract upload & inflated-LH-no-overlay fail)

seed_data_creation: Reused /app/frontend/public/atlases/wang2015_maxprob.nii.gz (as lesion) and /app/frontend/public/atlases/conte69_lh_inflated.gii (as tract test file).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two specific bugs remain for E1 to fix. After fix, retest by: (a) uploading conte69_lh_inflated.gii via upload-tract-button → expect tract entry to appear in Tractography list (data-testid=tract-tract-*); (b) clicking toggle-inflated-lh WITHOUT selecting an overlay first → expect no console TypeError and inflated mesh to render in 3D view. All other flows (Clear All, MNI152 load, slice modes, clip plane, individual lesion remove, inflated reload WITH overlay) are working correctly as of iter 5.
rca_of_the_issue: (1) Tract upload bug: FileUploader.jsx:22-32 validates filename against a hardcoded list of nii/nii.gz/mgz/mgh extensions before calling onFile. The component receives `accept=".trk,.tck,.trx,.vtk,.gii,.mz3,.obj,.stl,.ply"` from Dashboard but only uses it for the <input accept=> attribute (which controls the OS file picker filter, not validation). When set_input_files programmatically attaches a .gii, the validator immediately toasts 'Unsupported file format' and returns. Fix: parse `accept` prop into an allowlist or skip validation when accept is non-default. (2) Inflated LH bug: NiivueViewer.loadInflatedBrain builds a loadMeshes payload `[{url:meshUrl, name:id, rgba255:[...], layers:[]}]`. Niivue's addMeshesFromUrl maps over each mesh entry and eventually calls getFileExt on a value that is undefined when layers is an empty array. This is reproducible 100% of the time when inflatedOverlay state is '' (default) and the user clicks LH/RH toggle for the first time. The second click works because the test then selected Polar Angle overlay and called inflated-reload, which passes layers:[{url:'/atlases/benson14_polar_angle.nii.gz', ...}]. RCA: niivue library does not gracefully handle layers:[] in its loadMeshes path. Fix: in loadInflatedBrain, only include the `layers` key when overlayUrl is truthy.
